parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, facility ban, border or police targeting is documented, and bathroom access is expressly protected. Hate-crime and anti-discrimination law covers gender identity, with an official equality complaints body and emergency-service reporting guidance evidencing functioning recourse. Self-ID, marriage, adoption and related resident-facing reforms are treated only as climate signals, not traveller protections. Police-recorded hate-crime counts are small, not disaggregated by target, and therefore do not establish a trans-specific rate; the statement queer people face higher victimisation is unquantified. Strong public acceptance signals support safety, but there is no documented trans-specific enforcement outcome, custody, ward or service-audit evidence, so it sits at the lower end of low risk rather than near 0.95.
